title: Self-Directed Learning
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Diagnose your own knowledge gaps, find resources independently, and structure your own plan to close them.

steps.title: Map what you know
steps.text: Lay out your current understanding honestly, including the fuzzy edges.

steps.title: Name the gap
steps.text: Pinpoint what you need to learn and why it matters for the task ahead.

steps.title: Find the right resources
steps.text: Choose credible, suitable sources — and judge them (see Source Evaluation).

steps.title: Make a learning plan
steps.text: Set concrete goals and a realistic sequence, not just an intention to study.

steps.title: Check your progress
steps.text: Test yourself against the goal and adjust the plan as you learn.

feedForward.text: Write one gap you need to close this week, the resource you will use, and how you will know you have closed it.
